blocks.prompt: 5. A projectile is launched vertically upward from an initial height of \(s_0\) feet with an initial velocity of \(v_0\) ft/s. Neglecting air resistance, show that its height \(s(t)\) above the ground at time \(t\) is given by \(s(t) = -\frac{1}{2}gt^{2} + v_0t + s_0\) where, \(g > 0\) is the magnitude of the acceleration due to gravity.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh "show that" (saabit karo) wala sawal hai; jawab pehle se diya hai, humein raasta dikhana hai.
Diya kya hai? Cheez upar ki taraf phenki gayi, shuru ki unchai \(s_0\), shuru ki velocity \(v_0\); hawa ki rukawat nahin.
Rule kaunsa? Upar ko positive maanein to gravity neeche kheenchti hai, yani \(a(t) = -g\). Phir do dafa integrate.
Plan: \(v = \int a\,dt\) aur \(v(0) = v_0\); phir \(s = \int v\,dt\) aur \(s(0) = s_0\).
steps:
Diya gaya: zameen se \(s_0\) unchai se \(v_0\) velocity ke saath seedha upar phenka gaya; hawa ki rukawat nahin.
Saabit karna: \(s(t) = -\frac{1}{2}gt^{2} + v_0t + s_0\).
Tareeqa: \(s\) ko zameen se upar ki taraf naapein. Sirf gravity ka acceleration hai, jis ka size \(g\) hai aur rukh neeche, is liye \(a(t) = -g\). Do dafa integrate karenge.

Velocity
\[v(t) = \int (-g)\,dt = -gt + c_1\]
\[v(0) = v_0 \Rightarrow c_1 = v_0\]
\[v(t) = -gt + v_0\]
Kyun: \(g\) constant hai, us ka integral \(gt\). \(t = 0\) par sirf \(c_1\) bachta hai, jo shuru ki velocity \(v_0\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(a = +g\) le lena ghalat hai; upar positive hai aur gravity neeche, is liye minus.

Unchai
\[s(t) = \int (-gt + v_0)\,dt\]
\[= -\dfrac{1}{2}gt^{2} + v_0t + c_2\]
Kyun: \(\int t\,dt = \frac{t^{2}}{2}\), aur \(v_0\) constant hai to us ka integral \(v_0t\).

\(s(0) = s_0\) lagayein
\[s_0 = 0 + 0 + c_2 \Rightarrow c_2 = s_0\]
\[s(t) = -\dfrac{1}{2}gt^{2} + v_0t + s_0\]
Kyun: shuru ki unchai doosra constant tay karti hai.

Tasdeeq
\(s'(t) = -gt + v_0 = v(t)\), \(s''(t) = -g\;\checkmark\); \(s(0) = s_0\) aur \(s'(0) = v_0\;\checkmark\). Yeh wahi formula hai jo physics mein \(s = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\) ki shakal mein parhte hain, yahan \(a = -g\) aur shuru ki unchai bhi shamil hai.
